body.name: Alg
body.sig: \(\mathsf A:(G,T,e,\delta)\mapsto\begin{cases}(\operatorname{tree},d_e(G),(\rho_1,\ldots,\rho_{d_e(G)})),&|D\setminus T|=0,\ d_e(G)<\infty,\\(\operatorname{tree},\infty),&|D\setminus T|=0,\ d_e(G)=\infty,\\(\operatorname{algebraic},\mathcal J_{G,e},2^{|D|-n+2}),&|D\setminus T|>0,\ d_e(G)<\infty,\\(\infty,\mathcal N_{G,e}),&|D\setminus T|>0,\ d_e(G)=\infty.\end{cases}\)
body.def: The dispatcher specified in \(\mathrm{def:certificate\mbox{-}algorithm}\).  On the zero-excess tree class it returns the exact \(1/2/\infty\) classification and the one or two finite \(\operatorname{FASTP}\) expressions \(\rho_i\).  On positive excess it returns only the randomized Jacobian-rank algebraic/transcendental tag, the universal degree upper bound on the algebraic branch, or the dominance certificate on the transcendental branch.
